```yaml
name: PR Preview Deployment

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'website/**'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  preview:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
      CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '6.x'

      - name: Build website
        run: |
          dotnet publish ./website -c Release -o ./website-publish

      - name: Upload preview artifact
        id: upload
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: website-preview
          path: ./website-publish
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Deploy to Cloudflare Pages
        if: ${{ env.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN && env.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
        id: deploy
        uses: cloudflare/wrangler-action@v3
        with:
          apiToken: ${{ env.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN }}
          accountId: ${{ env.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          command: pages deploy
          workingDirectory: ./website-publish
          quiet: true
          environment: preview

      - name: Capture Cloudflare deployment URL
        if: ${{ steps.deploy.outcome == 'success' }}
        id: cf
        run: |
          echo "url=${{ steps.deploy.outputs.pages-deployment-alias-url }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Set preview URL
        id: preview_url
        run: |
          if [ -n "${{ steps.cf.outputs.url }}" ]; then
            echo "preview_url=${{ steps.cf.outputs.url }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            echo "preview_url=No Cloudflare deployment configured. Download the preview artifact below." >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Find existing preview comment
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        id: find_comment
        with:
          script: |
            const { data: comments } = await github.rest.issues.listComments({
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              issue_number: context.issue.number
            });
            const marker = '## RazorConsole PR Preview';
            const comment = comments.find(c => c.body.includes(marker));
            return comment ? comment.id : null;

      - name: Post or update preview comment
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        uses: peter-evans/create-or-update-comment@v4
        with:
          issue-number: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
          comment-id: ${{ steps.find_comment.outputs.result }}
          body: |
            ## RazorConsole PR Preview

            **Website preview**:
            ${{ steps.preview_url.outputs.preview_url }}

            **Download artifact**:
            [Download](${{
              github.server_url
            }}/${{
              github.repository
            }}/actions/runs/${{
              github.run_id
            }}/artifacts/${{
              steps.upload.outputs.artifact-id
            }})
```
